hooks.command: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git fetch --quiet origin main 2>/dev/null && behind=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$behind" ] && [ "$behind" -gt 5 ] && printf '{"systemMessage":"⚠ Branch %s is %d commits behind origin/main. Run: git merge origin/main"}' "$(git branch --show-current)" "$behind" || true
